title: Rabbi Abba HaKohen
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Rosh Hashanah 15b](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_Hashanah.15b.7-8), where he said to Rabbi Yose HaKohen: "Why did Rabbi Yochanan stay silent and not answer Resh Lakish?" And in [Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 5:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Sheviit.5.1.3), this statement is in the name of Rabbi Bun bar Kahana. He is also mentioned in [Taanit 13a](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.13a.11), where he said in the name of Rabbi Yose HaKohen: an incident occurred and the sons of Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Chanina died. It is very far-fetched to say that Rabbi Yose HaKohen is Rabbi Assi, the colleague of Rabbi Ami, as is the opinion of Mishpachot Soferim.[^1]

notes.text: The Jerusalem Talmud gives the question to Rabbi Bun bar Kahana in the parallel discussion. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=5&lang=en) also brings the passages together.
